$comment: Registry of official sources for every list under data/. Every data file is regenerated from one of these sources by tools/data-pipeline/refresh.ts (CONVENTIONS.md §2). status: download-verified = downloadUrl fetches the artifact directly; landing-verified = landing page confirmed reachable but the download link is versioned per release (manual --local or link scraping needed); verify = URL/API not yet confirmed.

ch/migel.name: Mittel- und Gegenständeliste (MiGeL)
ch/migel.languageLayout: one workbook, one sheet per language (MiGeL D / MiGeL F / MiGeL I)
ch/migel.updateCadence: irregular, typically 1-2 revisions per year (validity 1 Jan / 1 Jul)
ch/migel.notes: Excel download links on the landing page embed the release name (…xlsx.download.xlsx/…) and change each revision. Download manually and run refresh.ts with --local.

ch/analysenliste.name: Analysenliste (AL)
ch/analysenliste.languageLayout: each language edition contains all three sheets (Deutsch / Français / Italiano); one file suffices
ch/analysenliste.notes: Excel download links on the landing page are versioned per release. Download manually and run refresh.ts with --local.

de/diga.name: DiGA-Verzeichnis (digital health applications directory)
de/diga.notes: FHIR API endpoint discovered from the site bundle; a bare GET returns 401 Unauthorized — access requirements (headers/API key) still to be verified. Fallback: HTML directory scraping (upstream scripts/scrape-diga.ts).

de/hmv.name: Hilfsmittelverzeichnis (HMV, §139 SGB V)
de/hmv.notes: Landing page reachable; the exact stable XML-ZIP download path still to be verified. Structure per upstream ingest: hv:HMV_GRUPPE/ORT/UNTERGRUPPE/ART/PRODUKT, code GG.OO.UU.APPP.

fr/lpp.name: Liste des Produits et Prestations (LPP)
fr/lpp.updateCadence: roughly monthly (archive number increments per release)
fr/lpp.notes: Download index page reachable; the per-release LPP<nnn>.zip URL must be picked from it (verify a stable 'latest' link). General info: https://www.ameli.fr/entreprise/professionnels-sante/exercice-liberal/nomenclatures-codage/lpp

us/hcpcs.name: HCPCS Level II code set (quarterly update)
us/hcpcs.notes: Landing page reachable; quarterly ZIP links are versioned per release — verify/scrape the current quarter's link when implementing the normalizer.
